A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Imperial officer''' was the commanding officer of the [[Clone stormtrooper|clone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Contrail/Legends|Contrail]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. When CT-4981's [[Unidentified clone stormtrooper gunner|clone gunner]] was wounded in battle, the officer ordered CT-4981 to kill him. The latter refused and broke the commander's jaw, resulting in him spending a year in solitary.
